novelty_flags.label: Theorem: joint observed-data sharpness
novelty_flags.one_line: The survey omits Fan, Park, Pass, and Shi (arXiv:2503.16098v2), a close general incomplete-data conditional-optimal-transport framework; distinguish the proposed response-pattern/sensitivity model from its identified-marginal data-combination setup explicitly.

soundness_flags.label: def:joint-feasible-polytope
soundness_flags.one_line: r_a(m|c) is defined only when κ(c)>0, but the displayed sensitivity constraints quantify over the finite stratum system without excluding κ(c)=0; restrict all such rows to positive-mass strata or define a harmless convention for null strata.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proposes a doubly robust estimator for average treatment effects in cluster-randomized trials with incomplete outcomes/covariates and sensitivity analysis.
The article bounds aspects of an ordinal outcome measured twice when some second measurements are missing, using scientifically motivated missingness restrictions.
The published paper casts causal partial identification with unavailable potential-outcome coupling as multi-marginal optimal transport and obtains an exact partial identified set.
The paper studies confidence intervals for the partially identified fraction benefiting in randomized trials with ordinal or binary outcomes.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2503.16098v2, revised October 2025; HTML manuscript dated August 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The manuscript gives a general conditional-optimal-transport characterization for finite-dimensional moment parameters with incomplete data, including convex/support-function results for affine moment models; it assumes two datasets identifying (Y1,X) and (Y0,X), rather than the proposal's pattern-selected latent arm marginals.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Fan, Park, Pass, and Shi (arXiv:2503.16098v2) to related work and state a precise non-nesting comparison: their two-data-source identified-marginal COT model versus the proposed overlapping response-pattern completion with bounded selection probabilities.
Repair null-stratum semantics by restricting r_a and every sensitivity row to c with κ(c)>0, and state that null strata contribute zero mass and are omitted from the LP index set.

Raise the field contribution beyond generic finite-LP sharpness by derive a closed-form endpoint, a verifiable strict-tightening theorem against a named coarser response-pattern model, or solve a nontrivial subclass of the network-certificate frontier with complexity and an explicit algorithm.

recommended_next_step: Revise the null-stratum definition and literature positioning, then advance the field-tier sharp partial-identification angle to Stage 0.
